title: Recommended profile
subtitle: Hand-picked for adventurous preview users.
config_toml:
[features]
apply_patch_freeform = true
artifact = true
codex_hooks = true
enable_fanout = true
multi_agent_v2 = true
plugins = true
prevent_idle_sleep = true
realtime_conversation = true
runtime_metrics = true
tool_call_mcp_elicitation = true
tool_search = true
tool_suggest = true
undo = true
voice_transcription = true

flags.name: apply_patch_freeform
flags.description: Use the freeform apply-patch path so pre-release editing behavior stays on.

flags.name: artifact
flags.description: Turn on artifact outputs and file-producing flows.

flags.name: plugins
flags.description: Enable plugin discovery and plugin-backed tooling.

flags.name: prevent_idle_sleep
flags.description: Prevent idle sleep so long-running sessions stay alive.

flags.name: runtime_metrics
flags.description: Expose runtime metrics and instrumentation surfaces.

flags.name: tool_call_mcp_elicitation
flags.description: Allow MCP elicitation during tool calls.

flags.name: tool_search
flags.description: Enable the tool-search UI for discovering available tools.
